desc: The B1911 Series embodies the rich heritage of the 1911 platform while integrating modern innovations for unparalleled reliability and accuracy. Built from 416 stainless steel and chambered in .45 ACP, the B1911 Series 1911s all feature VZ Grips for enhanced grip texture, dovetailed tritium night sights, and an ambidextrous thumb safety. Elevate your shooting experience with this exceptional firearm, where tradition meets innovation in every shot.
